project: SENSU Digital — enterprise site and interaction studies
purpose: Help SME buyers choose a service and submit an inquiry; let authorized staff process it; demonstrate six purposeful feedback patterns.
audience: SME business visitors, administrator, read-only staff, and developers evaluating the isolated lab.
language: English public example; use the client-requested language for new projects.
brand: Confirmed warm paper #f6f5ef and forest ink #173d30; restrained editorial B2B hierarchy; inherit the existing token system. Different page tasks need different compositions, not a repeated feature-card skin.
research: Use industry leaders for task architecture before generic inspiration. Apple informs clarity, direct response and continuity; do not copy its identity. Taste informs marketing composition and deliberate density, not dashboard dogma. Impeccable informs audience/task contracts, coherent states, responsive review and scoped finish evidence. Existing Motion, Radix and native CSS fit this codebase; no new dependency or copied third-party skill text.
authorization: The owner has authorized this local implementation, preview, verification, direct repair and update to the existing public repository/release. New projects must inherit their own actual authority; this example grants none.
decisions: Owner: fictional digital-services enterprise for SME customers; websites, systems, automation.
Owner: cream/forest restrained editorial direction; concise factual copy.
Owner: reuse the ten existing discovery answers; do not repeat the interview.
Owner: public home, services and three detail routes, method, about, contact and privacy.
Owner: visitor consultation without login; administrator and read-only staff.
Owner: name, company, email, service and requirement; searchable/filterable admin details and status.
Owner: new → in_progress → done; local data; explicit cleanup command.
Owner: desktop, phone, keyboard and reduced motion; fine springs and progressive presentation.
Owner: add six named advanced patterns and automatically generated UI/UX plus module specifications.
Later publication instruction: English public materials, retained copyright and no-modification source-available terms.
assumptions: No real company identity, endorsements, production service credentials, transactions or deployment target is supplied. They remain outside this fictional local trial.
The six studies are alternatives chosen by task, not a requirement to animate every business screen.

interactions.feedback: Current link and destination heading are visible.
interactions.motion: Press response 100–160ms; restrained page reveal; reduced-motion immediate.
interactions.recovery: Native link supports open-in-tab and browser history.
interactions.verify: Open services using pointer and keyboard; verify URL, heading and Back.

interactions.states: editing / invalid / submitting / saved / recoverable error
interactions.feedback: Immediate submitting label and duplicate protection; success only after persisted response; reference is selectable.
interactions.motion: Short progress/success transition; focus the result after form replacement; no ordinary-business confetti.
interactions.recovery: Preserve entered data on error; retry with the same idempotency key; reset returns focus to first field.
interactions.verify: Submit, match reference in staff details and audit; test invalid fields, repeat, timeout uncertainty and reset focus.

interactions.states: editing / signing in / invalid / limited / authenticated
interactions.feedback: Disable duplicate submission; show specific recovery; navigate only after session acknowledgment.
interactions.motion: Restrained button press; error appears without layout jump; reduced-motion instant.
interactions.recovery: Keep email; do not expose secret or stack trace; allow retry after limit.
interactions.verify: Operate valid/invalid login and logout; anonymous admin API is rejected.

interactions.trigger: Advance an inquiry to the next legal status
interactions.states: new → in_progress → done; pending / conflict / forbidden / failure
interactions.feedback: Keep reference and current status visible; update summary/details/audit from successful response.
interactions.motion: Drawer spring 360/30, interruptible exit; restore focus to the originating detail action.
interactions.recovery: Conflict fetches latest version before retry; failed writes retain confirmed state; read-only role cannot mutate.
interactions.verify: Check two legal transitions, version conflict, audit actor/time, read-only 403 and dialog Escape/focus.

interactions.feedback: Explicit simulation; pending immediately; acknowledged success shrinks to a circle then draws check and emits ten decorative particles.
interactions.motion: FLIP silhouette spring 360/30; check 200ms after 120ms; particles 420ms; reduced-motion no displacement/particles.
interactions.recovery: Disable duplicate work; failed response retains review and provides retry; leaving study clears timer.
interactions.verify: Observe pending before success; inject failure, retry, reset and keyboard completion.

interactions.feedback: Checkbox, ring, count and light top surface share one count.
interactions.motion: Ring 280ms; numeric value 240ms; color 240ms. Retarget from current values; no per-frame React renders.
interactions.recovery: Uncheck reverses all feedback; textual final count remains available with reduced motion.
interactions.verify: Check/uncheck including rapid reversal; verify ring/count/text and zero/full states.

interactions.trigger: Open or gather the specification cards
interactions.feedback: Expanded state and label match the card arrangement.
interactions.motion: Spring 360/30; bounded 35ms ordering, reversed on gather; immediate reduced-motion layout.
interactions.recovery: Repeat reverses existing motion; hidden cards are not focusable; toggle retains focus.
interactions.verify: Rapidly open/gather; verify stable order, labels and no clipped text at phone width.

interactions.trigger: Scroll or move between workflow cards
interactions.feedback: Timeline advances after settled center selection, not at the first scroll pixel.
interactions.motion: Native scroll snap; prefer scrollend. Quiet fallback is only for browsers without it, requires released pointer/touch and center alignment within two CSS pixels; timeline draws 240ms after commit.
interactions.recovery: Previous/next and Arrow/Home/End retain access; reduced-motion navigation scrolls instantly.
interactions.verify: Scroll and use Next/End/Home; confirm centered card and timeline agree after settle.

interactions.trigger: Drag, key-select or choose a consultation slot
interactions.feedback: Selected time commits at rest; visible/native alternatives remain available.
interactions.motion: 44px tick; velocity projection 180ms; spring 240/29; 0.18 elasticity; bounded index 0–6.
interactions.recovery: New drag stops old animation; Arrow/Home/End and select provide alternatives; reduced-motion instant selection. If reduced motion becomes active during a spring, stop it and immediately commit the bounded target.
interactions.verify: Flick both ways and over bounds; interrupt settling; compare spinbutton, native select and selected-time text.

interactions.feedback: URL query and active link identify actual content; Back/Forward restores selection.
interactions.motion: Circle begins at input coordinates or keyboard trigger center; radius covers farthest corner; 380ms ease; reduced-motion instant. Keep the actual origin even when the tab is below the panel; remove clipping after settlement so resizing remains safe.
interactions.recovery: Last navigation wins; old layer inert and hidden from accessibility; no hidden focus targets.
interactions.verify: Operate all views, preference checkbox, rapid switch, keyboard Enter, Back/Forward and reduced motion.

frontend.spec: Use the existing React SSR, React Router and Vite modules. Keep public templates and admin components separate by responsibility. The lab is an isolated route with query-driven study/view selection. Every enabled control has the target defined in INTERACTION-SPECS. Preserve semantic links, headings, labels, native validation, keyboard order and focus after asynchronous replacements. Inherit src/tokens.css and use scoped lab CSS. Design at real content lengths; inspect desktop 1440px and phone 390px plus the actual preview viewport.

backend.spec: Same-origin Express API: GET /api/health, GET /api/session, POST /api/login, POST /api/logout, POST /api/inquiries, GET /api/admin/inquiries, GET /api/admin/inquiries/:id, PATCH /api/admin/inquiries/:id. Public inquiries accept strict validated fields, consent, honeypot and idempotency. Staff queries support search/status/pagination. Update includes expected version, legal transition and transactional audit. Return structured validation, 401, 403, conflict and rate-limit errors; inspect actual server schemas before implementing consumers. Lab completion is local simulation and must never call the inquiry write endpoint.

auth.spec: Visitors consult without login. Staff session is server-owned and persistent; administrator can read/update, viewer can only read. Never use hidden buttons as authorization. Rotate session on login, destroy on logout, HttpOnly/SameSite cookie, same-origin and CSRF checks for mutations. Generate isolated local credentials via npm run setup; retrieve from .local/demo-access.json and never publish them. Test anonymous, viewer, administrator, invalid/limited login, stale session and logout.

data.spec: SQLite local file .local/sensu.sqlite stores users, persistent sessions, inquiries and status audit. Inquiry fields include reference, name, company, email, service, description, status, version and timestamps. Status is new → in_progress → done. Save status and audit atomically. Keep test data isolated. Check persistence across restart. The explicit data:clear command requires a named scope and preserves staff accounts unless separately authorized. Do not publish database, runtime secret, sessions or local credentials.

content.spec: Chinese, concise and factual was the original client-trial decision. This separately published example uses English under the later publication instruction. Fictional SENSU offers websites, business systems and automation to SMEs. Explain audience, scope, exclusions and outputs; never invent customers, results, awards or testimonials. Privacy is a local-demo explanation. No transactions are in scope, so do not fabricate prices, refund policy or a unilateral final-interpretation clause. Confirm actual company/legal/media permissions before a real commercial launch.

preview.spec: Node 22.13+ below 23; npm ci, npm run setup, npm run dev. Default localhost port 4319; use a verified-free PORT for an isolated enhancement preview. Run production build and npm start separately. Track PID, cwd, port and mode; stop only the owned process. Open the actual browser and inspect CSS viewport and rendered controls. Keep public example, fixture tests and runtime secrets separate. Host without browser can provide source/build evidence but must mark UI operation NOT_RUN.

acceptance.spec: Map every Ixx contract to an operated scenario and evidence. Test normal, pending, failure, duplicate, unauthorized, stale version, empty and recovery paths relevant to that action. Verify desktop/phone, focus, keyboard, reduced motion and rapid reversal; drag/settle evidence is separate from screenshots. Run npm test, npm run build and production HTTP route checks; verify database/session restart where affected. Record PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN, actual command/exit, source revision and limits. Retain failed attempts and repairs. Physical devices, frame-rate certification and other agent hosts are NOT_RUN unless actually tested.

design.composition: Use the existing editorial brand on public service pages: clear business proposition, specific service choices and a visible inquiry path. Treat administration as an operational record workspace. Treat the lab as an index plus one active mechanism and its explanation. Do not repeat one marketing-card grid across these different tasks.
design.typography: Inherit --font from src/tokens.css: installed PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei and system sans fallbacks; no custom font license is claimed. The winning shared body rule is 16px/1.7; lab body typically 11–13px, metadata 9–11px, scene headings 16–32px, display 35px on phones up to 54px on desktop. Keep text readable at the actual viewport and browser zoom; headings need a clear hierarchy, not repeated labels above them.
design.color: Paper #f6f5ef; pale #edf0e6; ink #173d30; green #245b46; muted #58685f; line #dce2d5. Use green/ink for state and focus, tinted pale surfaces for grouping. Error state has written recovery as well as a muted rust treatment. Validate text contrast in the actual combinations; color never carries state alone.
design.spacing: Existing radius tokens are 14px and 8px. The lab uses fine borders, 5–8px specimen surfaces and 28px completion pill/circle geometry. Desktop shell uses 52px side gutters; phone 20px. Group related controls tightly; separate content, state and explanation. Reserve enough card height for phone wrapping; use fluid minmax columns rather than fixed page widths.
design.components: Reuse Radix dialog/icons and native button, link, checkbox, select and form semantics. Controls have visible hover/focus/pressed/disabled states; ordinary hit targets are at least 44px, including label hit area. A disabled control needs an understandable reason. Use a consistent SVG icon vocabulary. Keep success button DOM/focus stable; collapse hidden content and outgoing transition layers must not add focus targets.
design.navigation: Public primary navigation: Home, Services, Approach, About, with inquiry as primary CTA and privacy/staff entry in supporting navigation. Service details return to the service index. The separate lab uses six study links and query-driven view links; honor history, modified clicks and keyboard activation. Admin has search/status/paging and record details, not public marketing navigation.
design.feedback: Distinguish press, pending, confirmed result, recoverable error, empty, disabled and interrupted states. Derive coordinated visuals from a single business state. Success follows the real response; lab work is labeled simulation. Stop in-flight motion when reduced motion becomes active. Avoid fake progress, duplicate writes, lost form input and hidden errors.
design.accessibility: Semantic landmarks/headings; meaningful labels; visible keyboard focus; stable focus after async form replacement and dialog exit; native alternatives for gestures; written final state; aria-live only for useful results. Respect live prefers-reduced-motion changes, touch scrolling outside contained gestures and zoom. Browser operation is not a full assistive-technology audit.
design.responsive: Inspect 1440px desktop, 390px phone and the actual in-app width. Phone layouts expose action and state without hover; admin record details remain operable. Lab index becomes two columns above one canvas. Prevent page overflow and clipped copy, but verify task completion separately. Resizing a completed radial view must not leave a stale pixel clip.
design.assets: Fictional brand and authored mechanism scenes; existing architectural illustration is labeled synthetic. Do not invent client logos, awards, portraits, recordings or customer outcomes. Verify rights/provenance before adding real assets. No third-party skill content or brand skin is copied.
